args.title: Modify error toast behavior for screen readers
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Changes are needed to address accessibility concerns. Error toasts should use an assertive live region instead of the polite one. Also, they should not auto-dismiss after five seconds to ensure that screen readers have ample time to notify the user. This change ensures better accessibility compliance by making error messages more noticeable to assistive technologies.
